title: Feng Shui Nature Wallpaper: Serene Mountain Landscape
title_zh: 風水自然壁纸：寧靜山景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This serene mountain landscape wallpaper embodies the essence of Wood (木) and Water (水), with lush greenery and flowing streams creating a harmonious balance. From a Western astrology perspective, this image resonates with the energy of Neptune, promoting intuition and spiritual connection. The chakra alignment is primarily associated with the Heart Chakra (Anahata), fostering emotional healing and inner peace. For those seeking career guidance, this imagery aligns well with creative and nature-oriented professions, such as landscape design or environmental consultancy. Use this wallpaper as your phone background during meditation sessions or when you need to reconnect with your inner tranquility.
description_zh: 此寧靜山景壁纸以木（綠色）和水（藍綠色）為主，繁茂的樹木與潺潺流水構成和諧平衡。從西方占星學角度，此圖契合海王星能量，有助提升直覺與靈性連結。經絡對應心輪（Anahata），促進情感療癒與內心平和。命理上適合從事創意或與自然相關的職業，如園藝設計或環保諮詢。建議於冥想時或需要重新連接內心寧靜時使用。

title: Cosmic Tree Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 宇宙樹風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This mesmerizing wallpaper blends celestial energy with natural symbolism, creating a powerful Feng Shui phone background. The dominant visual elements are the deep teal and gold cosmic swirls, evoking the Water element (水) and its connection to intuition, emotions, and the subconscious. The golden streaks symbolize Fire (火), representing passion, creativity, and transformation. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), Water generates Metal (金), making this combination ideal for those seeking clarity, wisdom, and spiritual growth. This design resonates with the Sagittarius zodiac sign, governed by Jupiter, and activates the Crown Chakra (第七脈輪), enhancing spiritual awareness and inner vision. Perfect for use as a lock screen or home screen during evening hours, this wallpaper harmonizes Yin energy with cosmic flow, promoting calmness and introspection.
description_zh: 此圖案融合宇宙能量與自然象徵，是極佳的風水手機壁紙。主視覺元素為深青綠與金色宇宙漩渦，象徵水（水）元素，對應直覺、情感與潛意識；金色光線則代表火（火），象徵熱情、創造力與轉化。根據五行相生循環，水生金，此組合適合追求清晰、智慧與靈性成長的人。此設計與射手座（木星主宰）相呼應，激活頂輪（第七脈輪），提升靈性覺醒與內在視野。適合作為鎖屏或主屏，尤其在夜晚使用，可調和陰性能量與宇宙流動，促進寧靜與內省。

title: Blue Dragon Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 藍龍風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This striking wallpaper features a majestic blue dragon amidst swirling golden clouds, embodying the powerful energy of Water (水) and Metal (金). In Western astrology, this imagery resonates with the transformative power of Neptune and the intuitive depth of Pisces. The dragon's luminous yellow eyes evoke the Fire (火) element, symbolizing passion and vitality. From a Chinese metaphysical perspective, the dominant Water element is complemented by its generating cycle partner, Metal, creating a harmonious 喜用组合 of 水生金. This combination supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, enhancing intuition, creativity, and career success in fields like art, spirituality, and innovation. Ideal for use as a phone lock screen or home screen during early morning hours, this design promotes calmness, focus, and spiritual awakening.
description_zh: 此圖案以藍色神龍盤踞雲間為主題，主五行屬水，輔以金。從八字喜用神角度，水生金為最佳組合，對應腎經與膀胱經，有助提升直覺力、創造力及事業運勢，適合藝術、靈修或創新領域人士。畫面中龍目金黃，象徵火元素，增添熱情與活力。此設計適合作為手機鎖屏或主屏，尤其在清晨使用，能帶來寧靜、專注與靈性啟發。

title: Feng Shui Lotus and Goldfish Wallpaper for Positive Energy
title_zh: 蓮荷金魚風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a serene water scene with lotus leaves and vibrant goldfish, embodying the essence of Water (水) in Chinese metaphysics. From a Western astrology perspective, this imagery resonates with the energy of Pisces and the Neptune influence, promoting intuition, creativity, and emotional depth. The dominant Water element is harmoniously paired with Wood (木) in the Generating Cycle, as Water nourishes Wood growth. This combination supports the Liver meridian, enhancing clarity, adaptability, and personal transformation. Ideal for those seeking career opportunities in creative fields or individuals looking to cultivate inner peace and spiritual awareness, this wallpaper is best used as a home screen during morning hours to align with the day's fresh energy.
description_zh: 此圖案以蓮葉與金魚為主題，主五行屬水。依八字喜用神理論，水生木，故喜用組合為水木相生，對應肝經，有助提升靈活變通與個人轉化能力。適合從事創意領域或追求內心平和者使用，建議作為主屏於清晨啟動手機，以契合日間新氣。

title: Feng Shui Green Fish Talisman Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 風水綠魚符咒手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant Feng Shui talisman wallpaper features a serene green background with four graceful fish swimming around a central BaZi chart. The dominant element is Water (水), symbolized by the flowing fish and the calming green hues. According to the Generating Cycle, the favorable 喜用组合 for this image is Water生木 (Water generates Wood). This combination supports the Liver Meridian in Traditional Chinese Medicine and is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood deficiency in their BaZi chart. It enhances creativity, growth, and emotional balance. Ideal for use as a phone lock screen or home screen during the day, this wallpaper promotes a sense of tranquility and prosperity. Pair it with other green-themed accessories for a harmonious energy flow.
description_zh: 此風水符咒手機壁紙以寧靜的綠色為背景，四條優雅的魚環繞中央的八字圖。主五行為水（水），象徵著流動的魚和寧靜的綠色調。根據相生循環，此圖的最佳喜用組合為水生木（水生木）。此組合支持中醫肝經，對八字中木弱的人尤為有益，能提升創造力、成長與情緒平衡。適合作為手機鎖屏或主屏使用，白天可帶來寧靜與財運。搭配其他綠色主題飾品，可達成和諧的能量流動。

title: Feng Shui Ocean Waves Dolphin Phone Wallpaper
title_zh: 風水海浪海豚手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features dynamic ocean waves and playful dolphins, embodying the essence of Water (水). The dominant energy is associated with the Western astrological sign Pisces and the Sacral Chakra, symbolizing intuition, creativity, and emotional depth. In Chinese metaphysics, the Water element governs the Kidney and Bladder meridians, enhancing adaptability and inner wisdom. For those seeking harmony, the favorable 喜用组合 is Water生木 (Water generates Wood), ideal for individuals with a Wood deficiency or those pursuing careers in creative fields like art, writing, or design. Use this serene image as your lock screen during early mornings to boost calmness and clarity, or as a home screen for a calming presence throughout the day.
description_zh: 這張壁紙以動態的海浪和嬉戲的海豚為主題，象徵著水元素。在五行中屬水，對應西方占星學中的雙魚座及海底輪，代表直覺、創造力與情感深度。根據八字喜用神理論，水生木為最佳組合，適合木弱之人或從事藝術、寫作等創意行業者。建議清晨鎖屏使用以提升寧靜感，或作為主屏長時間陪伴。

title: Golden Immortal Feng Shui Phone Wallpaper
title_zh: 金仙風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This ethereal wallpaper features a celestial immortal in flowing golden robes, set against a backdrop of majestic mountains, clouds, and flying cranes. The dominant energy is Fire (火), symbolized by the radiant golden hues and the sun-like halo surrounding the figure. In Chinese metaphysics, Fire generates Earth (土), making this combination particularly auspicious for those seeking stability and grounding. This imagery aligns with the Western concept of solar energy and the Leo zodiac sign, evoking passion, creativity, and leadership. The secondary element, Earth, supports the stomach and spleen meridians, enhancing one's ability to manifest ideas into reality. Ideal for individuals in creative or leadership roles, this wallpaper can be used as a phone background during daytime hours to harness its vibrant, uplifting energy.
description_zh: 此圖案以一位身著金色華服的仙人為主，背景為高山雲霧與飛鶴，色彩以金色為主。五行中屬火，火生土，故喜用組合為火生土。此組合對應脾胃經絡，有助於穩定與實踐力。適合創意或領導類型的人士使用，可作為手機鎖屏或主屏，在白天使用以提升活力與靈感。

title: Feng Shui Moon Goddess Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 月神風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This ethereal Energy wallpaper features a celestial moon goddess gracefully standing on water under a luminous full moon, embodying the essence of Water (水). The dominant energy is associated with the planet Neptune and the Pisces zodiac sign, resonating with deep intuition, spiritual connection, and emotional flow. In Chinese metaphysics, this image aligns with the Water element, which governs the kidneys and bladder meridians, enhancing creativity, adaptability, and inner wisdom. The favorable 喜用组合 is Water生木 (Water generates Wood), making it ideal for those seeking inspiration and growth in their personal or professional lives. Use this wallpaper as your phone's lock screen during evening hours to amplify its calming and intuitive effects.
description_zh: 此能量壁纸以月神為主題，畫面中仙子立於水面，皎潔明月高掛，充滿水元素氣息。根據五行理論，此圖主屬水，對應腎經與膀胱經，有助提升創造力、靈活性與內在智慧。其喜用組合為水生木（水生木），適合追求靈感與成長的人士。建議作為鎖屏背景，尤其在夜晚使用，可增強寧靜與直覺能量。

title: Phoenix Goddess Wallpaper Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 鳳凰女神風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a divine Phoenix Goddess, embodying the essence of Fire (火) energy. The dominant red and orange hues, along with the imagery of flames and the celestial Phoenix bird, resonate deeply with the Fire element. From a Western astrology perspective, this image aligns with the Leo zodiac sign, ruled by the Sun, symbolizing passion, creativity, and leadership. The chakra associated is the Solar Plexus (Manipura), enhancing personal power and confidence. For those seeking balance, the favorable 喜用组合 based on the Generating Cycle is Wood→Fire. This pairing supports the Liver meridian, promoting emotional flow and growth, ideal for individuals in creative or leadership roles.
description_zh: 此圖案以神聖的鳳凰女神為主題，象徵火元素。紅橙色調與火焰、鳳凰鳥的意象強烈呼應火的能量。從八字喜用神來看，主火元素，喜用組合為木生火，對應肝經，有助情緒流通與成長，適合創意或領導類型的人。此圖亦可作為鎖屏使用，於早晨或下午時段觀賞，能激發內在熱情與創造力。

title: Feng Shui Nature Wallpaper: Ancient Beauty & Harmony
title_zh: 風水自然壁纸：古韵之美
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a serene scene of traditional Chinese artistry, blending natural and cultural elements. The dominant visual energy is Earth (土), represented by the majestic mountains, golden fields, and the grand ancient palace in the background. The secondary element is Metal (金), symbolized by the green dragon and the intricate details of the architecture. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), the favorable 喜用组合 for this image is 土生金 (Earth generates Metal). This combination supports the Spleen and Stomach meridians in Traditional Chinese Medicine, promoting stability, prosperity, and clarity. It is ideal for individuals with a Wood or Fire birth element, enhancing their career prospects in fields like finance, real estate, or education. For optimal Feng Shui benefits, use this wallpaper as a phone home screen during daytime hours, as it radiates positive energy and balance.
description_zh: 此壁纸以傳統中國藝術為主題，融合自然與文化元素。主視覺能量為土（土），由背景中的巍峨山巒、金黃田野及古建築所象徵。輔助元素為金（金），由綠色神龍及建築細節所代表。根據五行相生循環，此圖的喜用組合為土生金（土生金）。此組合有助於脾臟與胃經，促進穩定、財富與清晰思維。適合木或火命之人，能提升金融、房地產或教育等領域的職業發展。使用建議：作為手機主屏，白天使用，可帶來正向能量與平衡。

title: Feng Shui Five Elements Wallpaper: Green Goddess
title_zh: 五行壁纸：青衣仙子
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper features a celestial goddess in flowing green robes, surrounded by blooming flowers, graceful deer, and vibrant birds. The dominant energy is Wood (木), symbolized by the lush greenery and the ethereal, growth-oriented aura of the scene. In Feng Shui, this aligns with the generating cycle where Wood (木) generates Fire (火). Therefore, the favorable 喜用组合 for this image is Wood→Fire. This combination supports the Liver (肝) and Heart (心) meridians, promoting creativity, passion, and emotional balance. It is ideal for those seeking inspiration, artistic expression, or a boost in personal vitality. Use this wallpaper as a phone background during daytime to enhance focus and motivation, or as a lock screen to attract positive energy and harmony.
description_zh: 此壁纸以青衣仙子為主，周圍花團錦簇、鹿鶴相伴，充滿生機。主五行屬木（木），象徵成長與繁榮。根據五行相生循環，木生火，故此圖喜用組合為木生火。此組合對應肝經與心經，有助於提升創造力、熱情與情緒穩定。適合追求靈感、藝術表達或增強個人活力的人士使用。建議作為手機背景在白天使用以提升專注力與動力，或作為鎖屏以吸引正能量與和諧。

title: Golden Gourd Feng Shui Wallpaper for Prosperity
title_zh: 金葫蘆風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a golden gourd adorned with ancient Chinese coins, symbolizing wealth and prosperity. From a Western astrology perspective, the radiant gold color resonates with the energy of Leo (Sun) and Libra (Venus), promoting confidence, abundance, and harmonious relationships. The image exudes a warm, uplifting vibrancy that aligns with the Fire element's transformative power. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Metal (金), representing clarity, precision, and success. The favorable 喜用组合 follows the Generating Cycle: Metal generates Water (金生水). This pairing supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, enhancing intuition, adaptability, and career growth. Ideal for those seeking financial luck or creative inspiration, this wallpaper is best used as a phone home screen during daytime hours to amplify positive energy.
description_zh: 此圖案以金色葫蘆配古幣為主題，象徵財富與福運。從八字喜用神來看，主五行屬金，喜用組合為金生水。此組合對應腎經與膀胱經，有助提升直覺力、適應力及事業發展。適合追求財運或靈感啟發者使用，建議作為手機主屏，於白天使用以增強正能量。

title: Luck and Growth Wallpaper: Feng Shui Green Clover
title_zh: 綠四葉草風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This wallpaper features a dense pattern of vibrant green four-leaf clovers, symbolizing luck, growth, and prosperity. From a Western astrology perspective, the energy aligns with the planet Venus, associated with love, beauty, and abundance, resonating with the Taurus zodiac sign and the heart chakra. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Wood (木), representing new beginnings and vitality. The favorable 喜用组合 follows the Generating Cycle as Wood→Fire, making this design ideal for those seeking to enhance their creativity, career opportunities, and personal growth. Perfect for use as a phone background during daytime hours, it promotes positive energy and optimism.
description_zh: 此壁紙以茂密的鮮綠四葉草為主題，象徵幸運、成長與富足。西方占星學上對應金星能量，與金牛座及心輪相呼應；中國命理則屬木元素，主生機與活力。根據五行相生法則，木生火，故此圖適合追求創意、事業發展及個人成長者使用。建議作為手機鎖屏或主屏背景，尤適白天使用，能帶來積極能量與樂觀氛圍。

title: Feng Shui Mountain Sunset Phone Wallpaper
title_zh: 風水山巒夕陽手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper captures the majestic essence of a mountain range bathed in the golden glow of a setting sun. From a Western astrology perspective, the warm hues and towering peaks resonate with the energy of Leo, ruled by the Sun, evoking feelings of confidence, leadership, and spiritual illumination. The visual harmony of light and shadow aligns with the sacral chakra, promoting creativity and emotional balance. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Earth (土), symbolizing stability, grounding, and nourishment. The favorable 喜用组合 follows the Generating Cycle: 土生金 (Earth generates Metal). This pairing supports the lungs and large intestine meridians, enhancing clarity of thought and career success for those in fields like architecture, engineering, or real estate. Ideal for use as a phone background during daytime hours, this image inspires ambition and inner strength.
description_zh: 此圖案以雪山夕陽為主題，主五行屬土。土生金的喜用組合，對應肺與大腸經絡，有助提升清晰思維與事業成功，適合從事建築、工程或房地產等行業者。作為手機鎖屏或主屏背景，可激發雄心與內在力量。

title: Golden Mountain Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 金山風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper features a majestic golden mountain bathed in the warm glow of the sun, with shimmering water flowing through its valleys. The dominant energy is Fire (火), symbolizing passion, creativity, and transformation. In Western astrology, this aligns with the Leo zodiac sign, ruled by the Sun, which brings confidence and leadership qualities. For those seeking to enhance their career prospects or personal growth, this image resonates with the Solar Plexus Chakra, promoting self-esteem and inner strength. The favorable 喜用组合 based on the Generating Cycle is 火生土 (Fire generates Earth). This combination supports the Spleen and Stomach meridians, making it ideal for individuals in finance, real estate, or any profession requiring stability and abundance. Use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during the day to harness its vibrant energy, or as a lock screen for a subtle reminder of your inner power.
description_zh: 這張壁紙以金色山巒為主，沐浴在太陽的溫暖光芒中，溪流潺潺。主五行屬火，象徵熱情、創造力與轉變。西式占星對應獅子座，由太陽主宰，帶來自信與領導力。若想提升事業或個人成長，此圖契合太陽神經叢脈輪，有助增強自我價值感與內在力量。根據相生循環，最合適的喜用組合為火生土（火生土）。此組合支持脾臟與胃經絡，適合從事金融、房地產等需要穩定與豐盛的行業人士。建議白天作為主屏使用以吸收其活力能量，或作為鎖屏以提醒內在潛能。

title: Feng Shui Forest Wallpaper for Growth and Vitality
title_zh: 風水綠林手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This aerial view of a lush forest captures the essence of Wood energy, symbolizing growth, vitality, and renewal. From a Western astrology perspective, this image resonates with the energy of Taurus, ruled by Venus, which emphasizes stability, abundance, and connection to nature. The vibrant green hues evoke the heart chakra, promoting balance and harmony in one's life. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Wood (木), which generates Fire (火). Therefore, the favorable 喜用组合 is Wood→Fire. This combination supports the Liver meridian, enhancing creativity, decision-making, and emotional well-being. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood or Fire-based birth chart, as well as those seeking career paths in creative, nurturing, or leadership roles. For practical use, this wallpaper is ideal as a phone home screen during daytime hours, as it energizes and inspires productivity. Pair it with other green-themed accessories for a cohesive Feng Shui setup.
description_zh: 此圖為高空俯瞰的茂密森林，主五行屬木，象徵成長、活力與新生。西方占星學上對應金牛座能量，由金星掌管，強調穩定、豐盛與自然連結。鮮綠色調呼應心輪，促進生活平衡與和諧。根據八字喜用神理論，木生火，故喜用組合為木生火，支持肝經，有助提升創造力、決策力與情緒健康。適合木或火命局者，以及從事創意、關懷或領導類職業的人士。實用建議：適合作為手機主屏，白天使用可激發活力與效率；搭配綠色系飾品，增強風水效果。

title: Feng Shui Fire Energy Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 風水火能量手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a dynamic fire scene, embodying the essence of passion, energy, and transformation. From a Western astrology perspective, the vibrant flames resonate with the fiery energy of Leo and Sagittarius, activating the Solar Plexus Chakra and igniting creativity and confidence. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Fire (火), which generates Earth (土). Therefore, the favorable 喜用组合 is 火生土. This combination supports the Spleen and Stomach meridians, enhancing stability, nourishment, and practicality. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood (木) or Water (水) birth element, as it helps balance their energies by introducing grounding and nurturing qualities. Use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during the day to harness its energizing power, or as a lock screen at night to symbolize warmth and protection.
description_zh: 這張壁紙以熊熊燃燒的火焰為主題，主五行屬火。根據相生循環，火生土，故喜用組合為火生土。此組合對應脾胃經絡，有助提升穩定與實力，適合木命或水命之人使用，能平衡其能量。作為手機背景，白天用於主屏可激發活力，夜晚用於鎖屏則象徵溫暖與守護。

title: Feng Shui Mountain River Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 風水山水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper captures the majestic Matterhorn mountain bathed in golden sunset light, with a serene river flowing through the valley below. From a Western astrology perspective, the warm golden hues and the powerful mountain symbolize the energy of Leo (Sun) and Taurus (Earth), evoking feelings of strength, stability, and abundance. The flowing river represents the Water element, enhancing the sense of flow and adaptability. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is Earth (土), as the mountain signifies stability and grounding. According to the Generating Cycle (相生), the favorable 喜用组合 is 土生金 (Earth generates Metal). This combination supports the Spleen and Stomach meridians, promoting health, prosperity, and practicality. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Wood or Fire birth element, helping them achieve balance and success in careers such as finance, real estate, or construction. For optimal Feng Shui benefits, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during the day to harness its stabilizing energy, or as a lock screen at night to promote restful sleep.
description_zh: 這張精美的壁紙捕捉了馬特洪峰在黃金色夕陽下的雄偉景象，山谷中一條寧靜的河流蜿蜒流過。從西方占星學的角度來看，溫暖的黃金色調和強大的山峰象徵著獅子座（太陽）和金牛座（土），喚起力量、穩定和豐裕的感受。流淌的河流代表水元素，增強了流動性和適應性。在中國命理學中，主導元素為土（土），因為山峰象徵著穩定和接地。根據相生循環（相生），最合適的喜用組合是土生金（土生成金）。此組合支持脾臟和胃經絡，促進健康、財富和實用性。特別適合木或火命局的人，幫助他們在金融、房地產或建築等職業中實現平衡與成功。為了獲得最佳的風水效益，建議將此壁紙設為手機主屏，在白天吸收其穩定的能量；或設為鎖屏，在夜晚促進安穩睡眠。

title: Golden Mountain Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 金山風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper captures the majestic essence of golden mountains bathed in warm, radiant light. From a Western astrology perspective, the dominant energy aligns with the Leo zodiac sign, ruled by the Sun, symbolizing leadership, confidence, and vitality. The vibrant golden hues evoke the Fire element, which generates Earth, creating a harmonious flow of energy. This design is ideal for those seeking stability and ambition, resonating with career-driven individuals and those under the influence of the Fire or Earth signs.
description_zh: 此圖案以金色雪山為主題，呈現大地元素的穩重與壯麗。根據八字喜用神理論，主五行屬土，其喜用組合為火生土，對應脾胃經絡，適合命局中土旺或需補土之人。此圖適用於事業型人格，尤其對火土旺盛者有益，可提升穩定感與成功運勢。

title: Golden Waterfall Feng Shui Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 金瀑紫山风水壁纸
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This stunning wallpaper features a majestic golden waterfall cascading down a purple mountain, surrounded by ethereal clouds and radiant light. From a Western astrology perspective, the imagery evokes the energy of Neptune, the planet of intuition, dreams, and spiritual connection, resonating with the Crown Chakra (Sahasrara) and enhancing one's psychic awareness. The dominant element in this scene is Water (水), symbolizing depth, emotion, and flow. According to the Chinese BaZi framework, the secondary element should be Metal (金), as Metal generates Water. This 喜用组合 (Xiyong Zuhe) supports the Kidney and Bladder meridians, making it ideal for individuals seeking clarity, emotional balance, and spiritual growth. It is particularly beneficial for those in creative or healing professions. For optimal Feng Shui benefits, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during evening hours when the energies of Water are most potent.
description_zh: 此壁纸以金色瀑布自紫山倾泻而下为主题，云雾缭绕，金光熠熠。视觉上主五行属水，象征深邃、情感与流动。根据八字喜用神理论，水生金，故喜用组合为金水相生，对应肾经与膀胱经，适合追求心灵成长与情绪平衡者。此壁纸尤宜创意或疗愈行业人士使用。建议作为手机主屏，于夜晚时段欣赏，以增强水元素能量。

title: Feng Shui Mountain Landscape Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating phone wallpaper features a traditional Chinese mountain landscape, embodying the essence of Wood (木) energy. The dominant green hues of the lush mountains and vibrant flowers symbolize growth, vitality, and renewal. The red sun in the sky represents Fire (火), which is generated by Wood, creating a harmonious balance. This design is ideal for those seeking to enhance their connection with nature and promote personal development. The golden clouds add an element of Metal (金), which is nourished by Earth (土), further enriching the composition. Perfect for use as a home screen during daytime hours, this wallpaper brings a sense of tranquility and inspiration to your device.
title_zh: 風水山水畫手機壁紙
description_zh: 此款手機壁紙以傳統中國山水畫為主題，主導元素為木（木）。畫面中翠綠的山巒與鮮花象徵生長、活力與更新。天空中的紅日代表火（火），由木所生，形成和諧平衡。金色雲彩則帶有金（金）之氣，受土（土）所生，進一步豐富構圖。適合用作白天的主屏，為您的設備帶來寧靜與靈感。

title: Feng Shui Nature Wallpaper: Bamboo Forest Sunrise
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This serene nature wallpaper captures the essence of a bamboo forest bathed in golden morning sunlight. The dominant energy is Wood (木), symbolizing growth, vitality, and renewal. In Feng Shui, this aligns with the Taurus zodiac sign and the Earth element's support for stability. The generating cycle suggests pairing Wood with Fire (Wood→Fire) or Water (Water→Wood). For optimal harmony, use this image as a phone background during daytime hours to enhance creativity and career opportunities. It resonates with those seeking balance and personal growth.
title_zh: 風水自然壁纸：竹林日出
description_zh: 此自然壁纸呈現竹林沐浴在金色晨光中的景象，主五行為木（木），象徵成長、活力與更新。在風水中，此能量對應金牛座及土元素的穩定支持。根據相生循環，木可與火（木生火）或水（水生木）搭配。使用建議：作為手機背景於白天時段，有助提升創造力與事業機會，適合追求平衡與個人成長者。

title: Feng Shui Five Elements Tree Wallpaper for Phone
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper captures the essence of Wood (木) energy, symbolized by the majestic tree bathed in golden sunlight. From a Western astrology perspective, this image resonates with the Libra zodiac sign and the Solar Plexus chakra, evoking feelings of growth, harmony, and vitality. In Chinese metaphysics, the dominant element is clearly Wood, making it ideal for those seeking to enhance their natural creativity and ambition. The favorable 喜用组合 follows the Generating Cycle: Wood generates Fire, so pairing Wood with Fire energy creates a harmonious balance. This combination supports the Liver meridian, benefiting individuals with careers in creative fields, entrepreneurship, or personal development. For optimal Feng Shui results, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during daytime hours to amplify its energizing effects.
title_zh: 五行綠木樹影手機壁紙
description_zh: 此圖案以巨木為主，沐浴在金色陽光中，象徵木（木）元素能量。從八字喜用神角度分析，木為主導元素，遵循五行相生循環，木生火，故木火組合為最佳搭配。此組合可強化肝經，適合創意、創業或個人成長相關職業者。建議作為手機主屏使用，並於白天觀看，以增強其生機勃勃的能量。

title: Feng Shui Talisman Wallpaper: Lotus Gourd Energy
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This elegant wallpaper features a beautifully ornate lotus gourd, symbolizing abundance, protection, and spiritual energy. The dominant element is Water (水), represented by the blue and green hues of the gourd and lotus. In Feng Shui, this aligns with the generating cycle where Water (水) generates Wood (木). Therefore, the favorable 喜用组合 is Water (水) supporting Wood (木). This combination resonates with the Kidney (腎) and Bladder (膀胱) meridians in Chinese medicine, enhancing intuition, creativity, and career growth for those seeking balance and prosperity. Perfect for use as a phone background, especially during meditation or when working on creative projects, this wallpaper promotes calmness and focus.
title_zh: 風水符籙手機壁紙：蓮花葫蘆
description_zh: 此圖案以精美的蓮花葫蘆為主題，象徵豐收、保護與靈性能量。主五行屬水（水），由葫蘆及蓮花的藍綠色調所代表。根據五行相生循環，水生木，故此圖案的喜用組合為水（水）生木（木）。此組合對應中醫的腎經（腎）及膀胱經（膀胱），有助提升直覺、創造力與事業發展，適合追求平衡與富足的人士。作為手機背景使用時，尤其在冥想或從事創意工作時，能帶來寧靜與專注。

title: Golden Wealth Flow Wallpaper - Feng Shui Phone Background
title_zh: 金流財富壁纸 - 風水手機背景
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This captivating wallpaper features a stream of shimmering gold coins flowing through clear, sparkling water. The dominant energy is Metal (金), symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and precision. In Western astrology, this aligns with the planet Mercury, associated with communication, intellect, and financial matters. The image exudes a sense of abundance and dynamic energy, making it ideal for those seeking to enhance their financial luck or attract new opportunities. According to the Chinese BaZi framework, the favorable 喜用组合 for this image is Water生木 (Water generates Wood). This combination supports the Liver meridian, promoting creativity, growth, and long-term success. It is particularly beneficial for individuals with a Metal or Earth birth element, as well as those in careers related to finance, business, or creative industries. For optimal results, use this wallpaper as your phone's home screen during daytime hours to harness its vibrant energy. Pair it with a blue or green-themed case for added harmony.
description_zh: 此壁纸以金幣在清澈水流中流淌為主題，主五行屬金（Metal），象徵財富、豐裕與精準。依八字喜用神理論，此圖最佳組合為水生木（Water generates Wood），可滋養肝經，助長創造力與長遠成功。適合金或土命局者，尤利從事金融、商業或創意產業之人。建議作為手機主屏，白天使用以發揚其能量，搭配藍綠色系手機殼更佳。

title: Feng Shui Five Elements Tree Wallpaper for Phone
title_zh: 五行綠樹風水手機壁紙
creator: Dao Essentia
avatar: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Ccircle cx='50' cy='50' r='50' fill='%23D4AF37'/%3E%3Ctext x='50' y='65' font-size='45' text-anchor='middle' fill='%230a0a0a' font-family='Arial'%3EDE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E
description: This enchanting wallpaper features a majestic, ancient tree bathed in vibrant green hues, symbolizing the Wood element. The intricate branches and lush foliage evoke growth, vitality, and renewal. From a Western astrology perspective, this image resonates with the energy of Jupiter, associated with expansion, abundance, and spiritual awakening. The warm golden lanterns hanging from the tree introduce a subtle Fire element, enhancing passion and creativity. For Feng Shui practitioners, the dominant Wood element is harmoniously supported by its generating cycle partner, Water (Wood→Fire→Earth→Metal→Water). This combination fosters emotional depth, intuition, and adaptability. Ideal for those seeking balance and inspiration, this wallpaper promotes a sense of harmony and connection to nature.
description_zh: 此圖案以一棵高大古樹為主，樹葉翠綠，象徵木元素。畫面中枝幹盤旋，充滿生機與活力。從八字喜用神來看，木為主元素，其相生關係中的水為輔助元素（木生火，火生土，土生金，金生水，水生木）。此組合有助於支持肝經和膽經，適合木命或水命的人使用，能提升創造力與靈感，適合藝術創作者或需要創新思維的職業。
